title: Connect ships as a Progressive Web App whose precaching service worker keeps the app shell available offline
content:
## Installable, and offline by default

Connect is a PWA: users can install it, and a precaching **service worker** keeps the app shell available offline — along with its in-browser database assets and registry-loaded editors. It is built on `vite-plugin-pwa` and Workbox, configured entirely through `powerhouse.config.json` rather than a separate PWA config file.

Offline support is on by default via `connect.app.offline`:

```bash
ph connect config connect.app.offline false
ph connect build --json '{"app":{"offline":false}}'
```

## Three behaviours worth knowing

**The worker is production-only.** During local development it is always disabled regardless of `connect.app.offline`, so hot-reload is never intercepted by a cache. A caching bug you cannot reproduce in `ph connect studio` is expected.

**Disabling is not a no-op — it emits a self-destroying worker.** Any worker installed by an earlier build unregisters itself and clears its caches on the browser's next update check. That matters because a service worker outlives the deploy that installed it: without the tombstone, users who visited the offline-enabled build would keep serving stale assets forever.

**Workbox runs in `injectManifest` mode with a hand-written worker.** Connect owns the worker source; your `globPatterns` feed the injected precache list, and your `runtimeCaching` rules are registered by that worker *after* its built-ins. Workbox is first-match-wins, and the built-ins (Google Fonts, the `/-/cdn/` registry assets, `powerhouse.config.json`) are registered first — so custom rules add coverage but cannot override a built-in rule for the same URL. A `urlPattern` is either a verbatim string or `{ source, flags }` rebuilt into a `RegExp`; function patterns are not supported. For `NetworkFirst`, set `options.networkTimeoutSeconds` or a slow network stalls instead of falling back to cache.

`connect.pwa` is validated at build time and only applies when `offline` is `true`; an unknown field, bad file handler or non-compiling regex fails `ph connect build` naming the offending field. It is build-time only — set it with `ph connect build`, not `ph connect config`, which writes the file but cannot rebuild the worker.

_Source: `apps/academy/docs/academy/03-Build/05-Launch/06-ConfigurePWA.md`, Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.45._
description: Controlled by connect.app.offline (default true), built on vite-plugin-pwa and Workbox injectManifest. Production-only; disabling emits a self-destroying worker.
